label: High Users(Active Long-Visit Users)
business_meaning: Users logged in recently and show comparatively high engagement with longer sessions.
risk_opportunity: Maintain strong engagement and encourage long-term loyalty.
recommended_action: Offer advanced features, personalized recommendations and loyalty benefits.

label: Low Users(Low-Usage Users)
business_meaning: Users spend comparatively less total time in the app each day.
risk_opportunity: Build stronger engagement and repeat-use habits.
recommended_action: Use lightweight onboarding, reminders and relevant recommendations.

label: Moderate Users(Short-Session Users)
business_meaning: Users visit the app regularly but their sessions are comparatively shorter.
risk_opportunity: Increase session depth and improve content discovery.
recommended_action: Simplify first screens and personalize the next best content.

label: Occasional Users(Lapsed Long-Session Users)
business_meaning: Users showed good engagement previously but currently visit the app less frequently.
risk_opportunity: Re-engage users and increase their visit frequency.
recommended_action: Run targeted reactivation reminders, personalized offers or win-back campaigns.
